description: Implementation of VisitService for managing patient visits in OpenMRS. Contains methods for retrieving, saving, ending, voiding, and purging visits and associated entities like VisitType and VisitAttributeType.

classes.name: VisitServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of VisitService managing core visit-related operations, interacting with VisitDAO for persistence and utilizing Context for privilege validation and session management.

methods.name: setVisitDAO
methods.description: Injects the VisitDAO data access object used by this service.

methods.name: getVisitDAO
methods.description: Retrieves the current VisitDAO instance.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns all visit types from the database.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns all visit types, including or excluding retired, based on argument.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Searches for VisitTypes matching a fuzzy search phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Validates and saves a VisitType entity.

methods.name: retireVisitType
methods.description: Retires the given VisitType with optional reason (though actual retiring logic not shown).

methods.name: unretireVisitType
methods.description: Unretire a previously retired VisitType.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a VisitType from the database.

methods.name: getAllVisits
methods.description: Retrieves all visits.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Fetches a Visit by ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Visit by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Saves or updates a Visit entity after privilege check.

methods.name: endVisit
methods.description: Ends a visit by setting its stop date.

methods.name: voidVisit
methods.description: Marks a visit as voided (implementation not shown).

methods.name: unvoidVisit
methods.description: Unvoids a visit (implementation not shown).

methods.name: purgeVisit
methods.description: Deletes a visit if not in use by encounters.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of visits based on various criteria including types, patient, location, date ranges, etc.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Fetches visits based on a VisitSearchCriteria object.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all visits associated with a specific patient.

methods.name: getActiveVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns active (ongoing) visits for a patient.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns visits for a patient, with options to include inactive or voided.

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes
methods.description: Lists all VisitAttributeTypes.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: retireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a VisitAttributeType, with an optional reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: stopVisits
methods.description: Automatically stops visits based on visit types and maximum start date, by setting their stop datetime.

methods.name: getVisitTypesToStop
methods.description: Helper: retrieves visit types that are set to be auto-closed.

methods.name: getVisitTypeNamesFromGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Helper: parses CSV list of visit type names.

methods.name: getVisitTypesFromVisitTypeNames
methods.description: Helper: matches visit type names to VisitType objects.
